teacherImport.jsonPasteHint: Ask the chat to return the questions as JSON and paste it here. This mode does not call the AI — no quota, no length limit.
teacherImport.jsonPastePlaceholder: Paste the JSON from your chat here...
teacherImport.jsonImageUploadError: Could not upload images to UploadThing. No questions were added. Please try again.
teacherImport.jsonCopied: Instruction copied — paste it into the chat.
teacherImport.jsonCopyFailed: Could not copy. Select the text manually.
teacherImport.jsonInstructionBody:
Return the questions in the following JSON format.

- Keep the questions IN BOOK ORDER.
- Do not skip any question and do not merge two into one — images are attached by position later, and a single shift breaks all of them.
- The "order" field is optional and unused in this mode: order comes from the position in the array.
- Return JSON only: no comments, no preamble, no explanations.
teacherImport.jsonNoneImported: No questions were added. Fix the following in the chat and paste the JSON again.

jsonProblem.JSON_INVALID: Could not read the JSON. Check that you copied the whole chat reply.
jsonProblem.JSON_TRUNCATED: The JSON is cut off — ask the chat to continue.
jsonProblem.NOT_ARRAY: No array of questions was found in the JSON.
jsonProblem.TOO_LARGE: The text is too long. Paste the questions in smaller batches.
jsonProblem.TOO_MANY: You can paste at most {max} questions at a time.
jsonProblem.OPTION_COUNT_INVALID: there must be between {min} and {max} options

jsonWarning.ANSWER_MISSING: no correct answer given — pick one manually
jsonWarning.ANSWER_UNKNOWN: the answer is not among the options — pick one manually
jsonWarning.LATEX_UNBALANCED: a formula is left open (odd number of $)
jsonWarning.IMAGE_TOKEN_STRIPPED: image marker removed — attach the image in the next step
